subject: D-RUG Monday: Interactive R plots on the web

messages.author: 8c8f0ca54c4a2459
messages.subject: D-RUG Monday: Interactive R plots on the web
parts:
Hi all,

At our next D-RUG session on Monday, Ryan Peek will give a talk about creating interactive plots on the web using the R Shiny package.  Shiny is a package from the creators of RStudio and a great way to share data visualizations.  Ryan will show the the basic makeup of a shiny app and walk through an example project.  You can see a preview of Ryan's work on Shiny here: http://aquapeek.shinyapps.io/thermohydrographs/

After Ryan's talk we'll have our usual co-work time, Q&A, and cookies.  See you Monday!

Noam
